description: ETL helper table for decoding flow names

schema.description: The unique ID of the flow
schema.name: flow_id

schema.description: The human readable name of the flow
schema.name: flow_name

schema.description: The timestamp from which the flow is valid
schema.name: valid_from

schema.description: The timestamp until which the flow is valid
schema.name: valid_to

schema.description: The user-provided identifier for the agent
schema.name: agent_id
